title: Spectrum Analyzer Software — Overview and definition
t: Spectrum Analyzer Software — Overview and definition
description: Measures and displays signal spectra with markers, masks, and EMI detectors.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Measures and displays signal spectra with markers, masks, and EMI detectors. Spectrum analyzer software drives swept or FFT-based analyzers, applies RBW/VBW, detectors (peak, quasi-peak, average), and limit-line masks for compliance testing. Real implementations include vendor suites (Keysight, R&S, Tektronix) and open tools around RTL-SDR/Airspy hardware. It performs channel power, occupied bandwidth, harmonic, and spurious measurements with uncertainty budgets.

EMI detectors: peak, quasi-peak, average, CISPR bandwidths

title: Spectrum Analyzer Software — Actual implementation
description: Measures and displays signal spectra with markers, masks, and EMI detectors.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. How Spectrum Analyzer Software is actually implemented. Spectrum analyzer software drives swept or FFT-based analyzers, applies RBW/VBW, detectors (peak, quasi-peak, average), and limit-line masks for compliance testing. Real implementations combine Instrument GUI, SCPI remote control, Python automation (PyVISA) with VISA library, instrument drivers, calibrated attenuators/cables. The implementation is verified by Verify with a -20 dBm 100 MHz reference: level accuracy within the instrument spec and frequency error below 1 ppm after warm-up

title: Spectrum Analyzer Software — Teaching-ladder exercise
description: Measures and displays signal spectra with markers, masks, and EMI detectors.
body: Signature edition. Signature-original methods and framings for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Teaching ladder for Spectrum Analyzer Software, simple to complex. Rank 1: name the tool's single core action (Swept and real-time FFT spectrum acquisition). Rank 3: run it once on a tiny input and check the output. Rank 5: combine two capabilities: Swept and real-time FFT spectrum acquisition and Marker, delta-marker, and peak-table measurements. Rank 7: chain its output into a neighboring tool (Signal generator control software) with a verification checkpoint. Rank 9+: automate the full workflow and teach it to someone else.
